IN PHOTOS: Residents look for salvageable materials from their burnt homes after a massive fire roared through the community of Gate 46 at Parola Compound, Barangay 275, Manila, on May 24, 2026. The fire which started around 3:00pm of May 23, reached Task Force Charlie around 5:15pm and declare fire out at 12:15am on May 24. An estimated 1,700 families were displaced by the fire and are now at evacuation centers of Barangay 105 and 101 covered courts, Vicente Lim Elementary School, and Antonio Villegas High School. The Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD) is already on site and are distributing ready to eat food packs to the fire victims. 

📸: Norman Cruz

data.text:
PCG ASSISTS IN FIRE RESPONSE IN PAROLA COMPOUND

The Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) assisted in response operations after a fire broke out at the Parola Compound in Delpan, Binondo, Manila on Saturday afternoon, the agency said in a post on Sunday.

The fire started around 2:50 p.m., prompting the Bureau of Fire Protection and volunteer groups to deploy 55 fire trucks, while the PCG sent floating assets including boats from its fleet and the Coast Guard District NCR-Central Luzon.

PCG personnel also provided first aid to affected residents as fire authorities brought the blaze under control at around 12:15 a.m. Sunday, BFP said.

📸 PCG
